comment: Fine-tuning configuration for HRRR Alaska alignment

instructions.lon_offset: Shift entire image east (+) or west (-) in degrees
instructions.lat_offset: Shift entire image north (+) or south (-) in degrees
instructions.west_adjustment: Adjust western bound specifically in degrees
instructions.east_adjustment: Adjust eastern bound specifically in degrees
instructions.north_adjustment: Adjust northern bound specifically in degrees
instructions.south_adjustment: Adjust southern bound specifically in degrees
instructions.rotation_degrees: Rotate image clockwise (+ degrees, not yet implemented in backend)
instructions.skew_x: Horizontal skew/shear in degrees (not yet implemented in backend)
instructions.skew_y: Vertical skew/shear in degrees (not yet implemented in backend)
